Frequency once per encounter

Trigger You finish an action on your turn.

Requirement You are in ash, dust, smoke, haze, rubble, or similar wasteland cover.

Attempt a Stealth check to Hide, even if you are currently observed and even if you lack cover or concealment. On a success you are hidden until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or force a creature to notice you.
